text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - The Japanese Food Agency said on Thursday it had bought 100,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 45,000 tonnes of Canadian wheat, 40,000 tonnes of Australian wheat and 40,000 tonnes of Canadian barley at its weekly tender, all for February shipment.
- The Philippines bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for January shipment, traders said Thursday. The purchase was for spring and western white wheat. Prices were not immediately available.

WHEAT TENDERS - Turkey's state grain board (TMO) opened a tender to import 200,000 tonnes of red and white milling wheat on Tuesday as planned, but a result was unlikely before the option closed on Thursday afternoon, a TMO official said. The tender was on a three-year credit basis, and wheat from the U.S., Canada, Argentina, Australia or the European Union would be preferred, according to TMO officials.

- Algeria has launched a tender to import 150,000 tonnes of French, U.S. or Argentine milling wheat, or any combination of the three, for shipment in January and February. The tender runs until Thursday.

WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan issued separate tenders on Monday for 270,000 tonnes of U.S. Grade 2 or better soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat for delivery between January 8-31. The Pakistani Ministry of Food and Agriculture invited bids to be opened at 1100 Pakistan Standard Time on December 22 and must remain valid until 1800 PST on December 23 for the supply of 270,000 tonnes U.S. soft white wheat in bulk plus/minus five percent buyer's option to be financed under the GSM 102 export program. In a separate tender, it invited bids to be opened at the same date and time, for the supply of 270,000 tonnes of Australian white milling wheat.

WHEAT TENDERS - Morocco will tender on December 16 to import 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat, European grain traders said. The wheat is for delivery between January 1 and January 10, they said.

BARLEY TENDERS - Libya is in the market to import optional origin barley, European grain traders said on Tuesday. Over the past two weeks Libya has been asking exporters for barley prices but without providing details over tonnages or shipment dates sought, they said.

BARLEY TENDERS - Saudi Arabia is in the market to import 500,000 tonnes of optional barley for February delivery onwards, European grain traders said. Traders said Saudi Arabia had not yet officially announced a date for the tender.

- Jordan will tender on December 19 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. feed barley or equivalent origin in one lot for shipment by end of January, traders said. They said offers must be received by Jordan's Ministry of Supply by December 19 with offers for U.S. origin under the GSM 102 programme.
BARLEY TENDERS - The Cyprus Grain Commission said it invited tenders for the supply of one cargo of 25,000 tonnes of feed barley, with the tender closing Tuesday December 17 and shipment in January.
MARKET TALK - India will import two million tonnes of wheat in fiscal 1996/97 (April-March) to augment domestic supplies and check rising prices, Food Minister Devendra Prasad Yadav said on Thursday.
...Talk was widespread in U.S. grain export markets early Thursday that India bought one million tonnes of Australian wheat overnight, U.S. exporters said.
